title: 2.1.35 Debug the Door
description: Fix a door-unlock condition that uses || where it should use &&. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Read the broken code
steps.instructions: The starter code is meant to open a door only when the player is alive AND has a key, but it uses || instead of &&.

steps.title: Fix the bug
steps.instructions: Change the || in the if condition to && so the door only opens when isAlive is true and hasKey is true.

requirements.title: && used to guard the door
requirements.description: if statement condition combines isAlive and hasKey with && (either order). Help: 2.1.29 (Logical Operators)
